thought.text: Server is up and listening on port 5195. Let me verify it responds over HTTP:

reasoning_content: The server is up and running, listening on port 5195. Note: It's listening on port 5195, not 18080 — the Kestrel endpoint configuration comes from appsettings (default launchSettings). Let's check the HTTP endpoint. In the appsettings.json.in template, Kestrel was set to http://localhost:18080, but the actual appsettings.json might be different. Let's check appsettings.json and test an HTTP request.

action.command: cat src/Bovis.Web/appsettings.json 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.dumps(json.load(sys.stdin), indent=1))" 2>/dev/null || cat src/Bovis.Web/appsettings.json; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "GET / -> %{http_code} (%{size_download} bytes)\n" http://localhost:5195/; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "GET /swagger -> %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:5195/swagger/index.html
